tweets.text:
DYK? Border security doesn’t stop at the border.

U.S. Border Patrol operates 35 permanent checkpoints across the country—each one a critical line of defense, screening hundreds of travelers daily.

And the impact is clear:
🔹 Over 10,700 lbs. of dangerous drugs
🔹 Valued at $74 million
Seized so far this fiscal year.

All stopped before they could reach our communities.
Checkpoints stand between criminal threats and the heart of America.

tweets.text:
Today, U.S. Border Patrol stood in solemn remembrance at the CBP Valor Memorial and Wreath Laying Ceremony.

New names were added to the Valor Memorial—etched in stone as a lasting tribute to those who made the ultimate sacrifice in the line of duty.

This memorial stands as a powerful reminder of the bravery, dedication, and selflessness of our fallen brothers and sisters.

We honor them today and every day.

Thank you, Secretary Noem, for standing with us in tribute.

tweets.text:
On Saturday, agents apprehended Jose Luis Landa-Barrera, a Mexican national trying to sneak back into the U.S. after being removed a couple of months ago. Biometric checks revealed he was convicted of sexual battery in Salt Lake City, UT, and sentenced to a year in jail. He now faces prosecution for felony illegal re-entry (8USC1326).

Illegal entry is a crime- and every time you attempt it, you will face consequences. No exceptions.

tweets.text:
CRIMINAL ALIEN APPREHENDED

In El Paso, TX, USBP's ATV unit drove up to an area where they found two individuals hiding under some brush. One of them is a violent offender previously convicted for assaulting a federal officer and served four months in jail. Now he's facing prosecution for:
▪️Felony illegal re-entry (8USC1326)
▪️Unauthorized entry onto military property (18USC1382)
▪️Violating security regulations (50USC797)

ICYMI- If you make illegal entry, expect maximum penalties.
